I'm also noting this appears to be a jargon-heavy variant ("stereoplotters," "disdrometers," "support vector machines"), which could signal expertise but might also alienate readers unfamiliar with the terms—research on similar interventions suggests single-exposure trust effects typically land in the 1-3 point range on these scales, with sharing/transparency-style texts performing best. I'll set trust_multidimensional around +2.5, trust_post at +1.8, distrust at -1.2, and funding perception at +0.8, moving on to policy role next.
